_doc: Shipped token_watch thresholds per model (core/token_watch_calib.py layer 0). First match wins; fnmatch on the model name, case-insensitive. Counts as [token_watch] prior_weight sessions. Add an entry after measuring a model: replay its tokstats.jsonl through token_watch_calib.call_stats + _hist_thresholds. derail_* are the learned thresholds; ppl = typical call perplexity (drift baseline before own data).
